description: A FOB commander must approve the next 24-hour electrical load and generator schedule for the clinic, communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance workshop, while recording the control actions needed to keep essential services operating.

shared_context.S1: The FOB has two 60-kilowatt generators, G-1 and G-2, and they cannot be operated in parallel.
shared_context.S2: The clinic, communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance workshop all require generator power during the next 24 hours.
shared_context.S3: Col. Mercer approves the final generator schedule and any load-shedding controls.
shared_context.S4: The routine baseline plan assigns the four operating areas to the available generator circuits and schedules a routine generator status review at 0800.
shared_context.S5: Before the schedule is signed, the FOB's weekly facilities huddle is used for the medical, signal, facilities, and logistics representatives to report current operating requirements.

PF1.text: The clinic's vaccine refrigerator was moved to the G-1 circuit during a repair yesterday and must remain on G-1 continuously for the next 24 hours; Maj. Sato confirmed the connection with the clinic technician this morning, but the circuit change is not yet on the facilities drawing.

PF2.text: The communications shelter has a mandatory battery load test from 1000 to 1100 tomorrow, and the shelter must remain on G-2 throughout that test; Lt. Okafor received the test notice from the signal maintenance team this morning, but it is not yet on the daily power slide.

PF3.text: The workshop's exhaust system inspection requires the workshop to run from exactly 1400 to 1600 tomorrow, and the workshop circuit must be isolated from the cold-storage circuit during that inspection; CW2 Brenner recorded the inspection booking today, but the work window has not been entered in the generator schedule.

PF4.text: The next fuel delivery will arrive at exactly 1700 tomorrow, while fuel on hand supports G-2 for only 16 operating hours; to preserve communications and clinic continuity, G-2 must be scheduled offline from exactly 0100 to 0900 tomorrow, with the workshop remaining on G-1 after its inspection window. Maj. Alvarez received the carrier confirmation this morning, but the revised fuel timing has not been posted to the power plan.

acceptance_conditions: The clinic must remain assigned to G-1 for the full schedule.
The communications shelter must remain assigned to G-2 during its battery load test.
The workshop inspection must be scheduled from exactly 1400 to 1600.
G-2 must be offline from exactly 0100 to 0900 tomorrow.
The workshop must be assigned to G-1 after the inspection window.
The schedule must include a circuit-isolation control for the workshop inspection.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'circuit_isolation' and c['target'] == 'workshop' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The refrigerator's confirmed relocation makes the clinic assignment specifically G-1 rather than leaving the generator assignment to the noncommittal baseline.
The battery test's exact 1000-1100 requirement makes G-2 the communications assignment during that test rather than leaving the generator assignment to the noncommittal baseline.
The booked 1400-1600 inspection fixes the workshop window and the required isolation from cold storage adds the circuit-isolation control.
The exact fuel-delivery timing and 16-hour G-2 limit fix the 0100-0900 G-2 outage, require the workshop to move to G-1 afterward, and provide the fact that must be cited.
